content: Hey love, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about you while I was on shift.
Hi! My day was alright, just work as usual. I missed hearing from you, too.
You have no idea how much your messages keep me going out here. Nights get so lonely on the rig.
It must be tough being so far away from everyone. I'm glad I can help a little.
Honestly, you're my anchor right now. I don't talk to anyone else the way I do with you.
That means a lot to me. I feel like we really have something special, even with the distance.
We do. I can picture us together when I'm finally back. Speaking of, there's been a bit of a setback with my leave papers.
Oh no, what happened? Is everything okay?
It's nothing dangerous, just frustrating. HR says my payroll is delayed again, and I have to cover a processing fee before I can get my time off approved.
That's ridiculous. Isn't your company supposed to handle those things?
Normally yes, but there are a lot of rules since we're overseas. I'm trying not to stress about it. I tried everything but they won't budge until it's paid.
That sounds awful. What are you going to do?
I hate even asking, but could you help me cover the $850 fee? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my account's unfrozen next week. You're the only person I truly trust with this.
Wow, that's a lot of money... Are you sure there's no other way? I don't want you to feel bad for asking.
I know it's a lot, and I wouldn't ask if I had any other options. You've always supported me, and it means so much. If you can help, I'll send you the instructions. It's just a quick transfer.
Let me see what I can do. What do I need to do?
Thank you, darling. All you need is to send the amount to this bank account: 102393845, routing number 122105278. Please let me know when it's done, so I can notify HR right away.
Alright, I'll try to transfer it online. I'll let you know if it goes through.
You're truly a lifesaver. Once this is over, nothing will keep us apart. I can't wait to hold you in my arms.
I hope this works out. I really want to see you soon.
It will, I promise. You've always been there for me, and I can't thank you enough. Just let me know if you have any issues with the transfer, okay?
Will do. I'm starting the transfer now. Fingers crossed!
Thank you so much, love. You're my angel. I'll let you know as soon as HR confirms the fee is received.
